title: Flutter Developer Intern
description:
**Flutter Developer Intern**

**Job Type:** Internship

**Experience:** Fresher – 6 months

**Location: Solaris Business Hub, 913, Sola Rd, opp. The National Higher Secondary School, Vardhmannagar Society, C.P. Nagar\-1, Naranpura, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380063**

**Work Mode:** On\-site

**Duration:** 3/6 months

**Job Description**

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Flutter Developer Intern to join our development team. This opportunity is ideal for freshers or candidates with up to 6 months of experience who want to build practical experience in mobile application development using Flutter and Dart.

As a Flutter Intern, you will work with our development team to build, improve, and maintain real\-world mobile applications. You will get hands\-on experience with UI development, API integration, debugging, state management, and application development practices.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain mobile applications using Flutter and Dart.
* Create clean, responsive, and user\-friendly mobile UI.
* Convert UI designs into functional Flutter screens.
* Integrate REST APIs into Flutter applications.
* Work with JSON data and API responses.
* Implement navigation and application flows.
* Learn and work with state management such as Riverpod/Provider.
* Debug and fix UI and functional issues.
* Test applications on Android devices and emulators.
* Collaborate with senior developers and team members.
* Follow clean coding and development practices.
* Participate in code reviews and improve existing features.
* Learn and implement new Flutter/Dart concepts as required.

**Requirements**

* Basic knowledge of Flutter and Dart.
* Understanding of Flutter widgets and layouts.
* Basic knowledge of:
* StatelessWidget
* StatefulWidget
* ListView
* Column
* Row
* Container
* FutureBuilder
* Navigation
* Basic understanding of REST APIs and JSON.
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub is a plus.
* Basic understanding of asynchronous programming (Future, async, await).
* Good problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Willingness to learn and work on real\-world projects.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* **Good to Have**
* Experience with Riverpod / Provider / Bloc.
* Basic knowledge of Dio or other HTTP clients.
* Understanding of Firebase.
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub.
* Experience building at least one Flutter project.
* Knowledge of responsive UI design.
* Basic understanding of MVC/Clean Architecture or similar architecture.

**Who Can Apply?**

* Freshers
* Recent graduates
* Students who have completed or are pursuing a relevant course
* Candidates with 0–6 months of Flutter experience
* Candidates who have built personal/college Flutter projects and want real\-world development experience

**What You Will Learn**

During the internship, you will gain practical experience in:

* Real\-world Flutter application development
* Dart programming
* UI/UX implementation
* REST API integration
* State management
* Git/GitHub
* Debugging and troubleshooting
* Mobile application testing
* Working with production\-style application architecture
* Team\-based software development

**Preferred Candidate**

We are looking for someone who is eager to learn, takes initiative, and enjoys building mobile applications. Strong knowledge is not required for a fresher, but the candidate should have a basic understanding of Flutter/Dart and be willing to learn quickly.

**Experience: Fresher to 6 months**

Education: Any relevant degree/diploma/course in Computer Science, IT, Software Development, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory if the candidate has good Flutter skills.

***Short Indeed Summary***

We are hiring a Flutter Developer Intern for our development team. Freshers and candidates with up to 6 months of experience are welcome to apply. Candidates should have basic knowledge of Flutter, Dart, REST APIs, JSON, and mobile UI development. The intern will work on real\-world Flutter applications and gain hands\-on experience in UI development, API integration, state management, debugging, and application development.

***Freshers with good Flutter projects are encouraged to apply.***

Pay: From ₹8,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment

Work Location: In person
